one_liner: Salesforce Commerce Cloud provides headless ecommerce APIs, sandboxes, and development tools.
auth_notes: OAuth2 with JWT tokens via Salesforce Account Manager and SLAS.
access_notes: Requires purchasing sandbox credits or a partner/enterprise contract via Account Executive.
api_notes: Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI) covers catalogs, products, shoppers, orders, and more.
blocker_notes: Requires sandbox credits and contract interaction with an Account Executive to get working credentials.

api.quote: The new B2C DX MCP server is a unified MCP that is the starting point for various development tools and storefronts. The B2C DX MCP server provides your AI assistant with real-time access to B2C Commerce APIs (SCAPI)

mcp.quote: Use the B2C DX Model Context Protocol (MCP), which is part of the B2C Developer Toolkit, to enhance your development workflow by connecting an AI assistant
